hero.title: The Entire History of Humanity. One Place.
hero.lead: Countries, empires, people and events — mapped, dated, sourced, and connected across five thousand years.

map.lead: Hover a country to identify it. The full atlas adds historical borders, period layers and comparisons.

footer.tagline: A digital museum, atlas and encyclopedia of human history.
footer.sourcing: Content is sourced from museums, universities and recognised reference works. Disputed dates are marked.

countries.title: Countries of the world
countries.lead: {{n}} countries and territories. Search, filter by continent or by historical period, and open any profile.
countries.noHistoryTitle: The historical article for this country is being written
countries.noHistoryBody: We only publish history that has been reviewed against reliable sources. Until then, here is the verified geographic profile and the civilizations connected to this territory.

explore.title: Atlas
explore.lead: Click any country to see its profile. Choose a civilization to see which modern states lie on its core territory.
explore.layerNote: Highlighted states are an approximation using modern borders, not historical boundaries. Reliable historical border datasets will be added as separate layers.
explore.compareWith: Pick a second country on the map
